measured_cost_of_prepare.instrument: tracemalloc current heap; the footprint in the same runs is inflated because tracing was on

root_cause.phase: runner.prepare(parents), not the two-phase cost ledger
proof: tools/profile_monthly_cost_ledger.py:691 runs runner.prepare(parents); the ledger is only reached at :697
ArchiveDisruptionProvider.disruption() calls cache.store() for every unit it prices, and the daily-cost cache root was EMPTY at the abort, so not one of the 1,950 units had been priced
the daily-results root was empty too
the demand release file was written about 120 s in; the footprint is flat at 200-420 MB until then and climbs monotonically afterwards
the profiler's resolver observer keeps counters and a 569-entry unique set only, so it is not the sink

supported_budget_for_a_re_authorised_run.memory_note: prepare alone projects to 4.78 GB of retained heap, and the published profile's LEDGER phase peaked at 6.07 GiB on top of prepare's floor. 10 GiB is the budget this chain used before the two-phase round lowered it to 4 GiB on ledger-only evidence
supported_budget_for_a_re_authorised_run.swap_note: the published profile grew swap by about 2.6 GB; a 1 GiB ceiling would stop a correctly-budgeted run for a reason unrelated to this defect
supported_budget_for_a_re_authorised_run.wall_note: unchanged; time was never the binding constraint here

why_the_budget_was_wrong.and_that_6_07_gib_is_only_the_ledger: the profiler's RSS sampler wraps build_cost_ledger only, so no run has ever measured prepare's own peak - this is the first measurement of it
why_the_budget_was_wrong.the_contradiction_was_already_on_disk: the same decision record carries published_profile_peak_rss_bytes 6,520,061,952 (6.07 GiB) beside memory_hard_bytes 4,294,967,296 (4 GiB). The published profile would itself have breached the budget set from it
why_the_budget_was_wrong.the_forecast_skipped_this_phase: wci_two_phase_canary_v1 calls build_cost_ledger directly and prepares only its 1-3 build keys' units; it never builds the product arm and never runs the month's prepare. The month footprint in the authorising decision is peaks[-1] + 27 * held_slope over LEDGER peaks alone, which is why it read ~1.5 GB
why_the_budget_was_wrong.the_two_phase_work_is_not_implicated: the ledger never executed. Its measured gains (195 parses to 3, 65 providers to 1, 1.77x wall on a build key) are untouched by this stop, and equally they are still unverified at month scale
